wildcardRationale.RegistryAuth: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken has no repository-level Resource scope. Explicit us-east-1 condition; image mutations still limited to three exact repositories.
wildcardRationale.ObserveDeployment: ssm:GetCommandInvocation has no resource-level permission scope. Explicit us-east-1 condition; retains broad invocation-output read exposure in that region. It does not grant SendCommand on other documents/instances.
wildcardRationale.Identity: Existing explicit sts:GetCallerIdentity statement has no resource ARN and grants identity observation only; it is not AssumeRole or authority.
wildcardRationale.ObjectSuffixes: Retained standing-contract choice, not an IAM service requirement: one exact artifact bucket and five dev read namespaces in the shared ceiling; operator uses only three namespaces. Commit/digest/operation keys are unknown until build/publication. Exact keys could be enumerated in a separately reviewed per-operation grant once known; this proposal does not add an IAM updater or approve arbitrary artifacts. The if-none-match star is a literal HTTP precondition, not an Action/Resource wildcard.
wildcardRationale.OptionalProviderEnumeration: Optional installation/retirement owner reads iam:ListOpenIDConnectProviders and iam:ListRoles enumerate account metadata and cannot be scoped to the provider resource ARN. Complete trust-consumer coverage is required before deleting a new provider; delivery operator never receives these rights.

retirement.externalIamOwner: The new operator role/boundary are outside that Terraform module and the KEEP-only three-policy retention contract. operatorRoleCleanup.preconditions: Exact captured RoleId/trust/inline digest; all runtime activity reconciled; only expected inline policy; no managed attachments/instance profiles/foreign consumers. Unexpected attachments block rather than granting generic detach.

boundaryCleanup.preconditions: Exact captured PolicyId and approved v1 only; all three boundary-consuming roles removed; attachment/boundary-usage counts zero; no other policy versions. Extra version requires fresh review, not default DeletePolicyVersion.

retirement.providerDecision: If GitHub OIDC provider is already shared, reference/preserve it without import/deletion. Existing apply reference lacks the complete delete rights; never hand it to delivery as a teardown grant.

privateCdOwnerActionGroups.precondition: Exact state-owned roles/RoleIds and inline names; no unexpected managed attachments/instance profiles; no foreign policy removal.
